Subject: Pen test report required for procurement gating (RDW-8921)

Hi Aditya,

As part of our procurement gating (MAP) for the Contoso Retail proof-of-concept, procurement needs a copy of your latest penetration test report and a short remediation status update for any medium/high findings. The procurement team needs to close gating by 2026-11-30 to keep the timeline for our winter rollout.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can provide an abridged/redacted pen-test report that we can attach to the procurement packet by 2026-11-29?
- The scope of the assessment (external/internal/cloud infra/application) and date the test was run.
- A remediation snapshot: which findings are fully remediated, in progress, or deferred (with owner and ETA).

If an abridged version is not possible, please advise on access to the full report and any NDA/process we need to follow.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi

Contoso Retail

Hi all — filling in the technical details. Summary below; I kept this short for procurement.

Scope and date: External and internal web/application layer assessment against our hosted API and control plane, conducted 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-17 by ClearWave Security (third-party).

Deliverables available:
- Full pen-test report (full technical detail, exploit traces, tester IDs) — available under access control (NDA or signed access form).
- Abridged/redacted report (suitable for procurement) — removes tester identities, PoC exploit code, and internal IP addresses.
- Remediation status snapshot (matrix).

Remediation snapshot (high-level):
- HIGH: 1 finding (JWT token expiry misconfiguration) — mitigated 2026-10-25, verified in internal scan. Owner: Security Engineering (JIRA: SEC-714).
- MEDIUM: 3 findings (1 authentication logic, 2 input validation gaps) — two mitigations deployed 2026-11-10, one in progress (workaround in place, patch scheduled 2026-12-06). Owner: Platform Eng.
- LOW: several informational items, deferred to backlog for prioritization.

We will attach an evidence ZIP containing scan outputs (sanitized) and the abridged PDF. The full report can be shared through a time-limited, access-controlled URL after Contoso signs the standard vendor access form; I can route that to your security contact.

Elena — please confirm whether a redacted PDF + remediation matrix meets Contoso's MAP requirements or if you need the full report behind an NDA.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
